instructions_zh: 下面的问题是询问您过去 30 天中的情绪。回答每一个问题时，请圈出最能描述这种情绪的出现频率的号码。
prompt_zh: 问 1. 在过去３０天中，您经常会感到 …
selected_form: Six scored K6 symptom questions Q1a–f, extracted verbatim from official K6+ self-report form; past30days. Not an entire reproduction of all K6+ supplementary questions.
excluded_fields: K6+ Q2 persistence/comparison; Q3–Q4 activity impairment; Q5 health-service contacts; Q6 physical-health attribution. Official author page says these are not required for K6 scoring. Administrative identifiers/demographics are not scale items and are not added to this research form.

items.en: …so depressed that nothing could cheer you up?
items.zh: …太沮丧以至于什么都不能让您愉快起来?
items.zh_draft: …太沮丧以至于什么都不能让您愉快起来?

scoring.mapping: printed_code 1,2,3,4,5 => score 4,3,2,1,0; do not confuse raw displayed codes with scored values; no construct-reversed items
scoring.missing: Platform conservative policy: all six valid scored answers required; any missing/invalid => no total, no band. Author FAQ does not impose one missingness rule.
scoring.direction: 较高表示这六类困扰报告得更频繁；不等于诊断

screening_reference.target: Research screening reference for serious mental illness in source study, not a diagnosis.
screening_reference.population_and_period: 2003 enriched US calibration, weighted for population estimation; worst-month-in-previous12months implementation differs from selected past30days.

reference_profiles.interpretation_policy: No mild/moderate/severe bands or percentile norms approved. Display continuous0–24 descriptive distress score only pending independent review; any future threshold display must name applicable population, period, language and source.
reference_profiles.prevalence_warning: Do not estimate SMI prevalence as raw percentage scoring13+ in arbitrary sample; official scoring FAQ warns calibration depends on population characteristics.

runtime_policy.activation: External dossier only. Chinese exact validation match unestablished; no severity or Chinese norm bands.

report.summary: 这份小记录关注过去一个月里，紧张、沮丧和做事费劲等感受出现得有多频繁。它像一张近况快照，不是给你下结论，也不评价你是否坚强。
report.meaning: 数值越高，表示这些困扰在这次回答里出现得越频繁。它无法单独说明原因，也不能据此判断是否患病。
report.everyday_example: 可以回想最近一件平常的小事：它是否比以前更费力？是偶尔如此，还是常常如此？具体例子往往比分数更有助于理解自己。
next_steps: 记下一件最近最费劲的事，以及当时让你稍微轻松一点的条件。
如果困扰持续或妨碍日常生活，可以与可信赖的人或合格专业人员谈谈。
report.limits: 目前没有为这个版本启用人群分档，因此不把你的结果标成轻、中、重。回答较少困扰也不证明完全安全或不需要帮助。
report.incomplete: 这次还有问题没有完成，暂不计算总分；这不表示没有困扰。
report.safety_unconditional: 本工具不评估自杀风险。若你此刻可能伤害自己或无法保证安全，请联系当地紧急服务并找可信赖的人陪伴。本页不提供实时监测或自动救援。

references.summary: Enriched convenience sample155; reference12-month DSM-IV disorder (excluding substance-use disorder) with GAF<60. Cutoff13+ on0–24 equalized weighted false positives/negatives; sensitivity.36, specificity.96. Critically, NHSDA implementation changed recall to the emotionally worst month within the previous12months. These performance estimates must not be presented as validation of the selected30-day Mandarin form.

critical_caveats: This is K6 scored Q1a-f, not full K6+; other forms not duplicated as separate tools.
Keep question prompt visible on every page: bare stems depend on it.
2003 >=13 threshold empirical calibration used enriched US sample155 and worst-month-in-past-year framing; cannot transfer performance to this past30day Mandarin form.
Do not call unrestricted author use public domain or CC0. Retain both current grant and historical PDF footer.
